pages.title: Huemul
pages.text: The huemul ($(o)Hippocamelus bisulcus$()), or South Andean deer, is a stocky deer native to the Andes of southern Chile and Argentina.$(br2)Its short legs and thick, coarse coat suit the steep, rugged terrain and cold climate of its mountain forests and grasslands.$(br2)The huemul is endangered, with only a few thousand left in the wild, and it appears on the coat of arms of Chile.
